title: A Systematic Investigation of Bias in Large Language Models for Advertising Relevance

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of advertiser names in advertisement text and URLs while keeping the search query and remaining ad content unchanged to measure differences in relevance judgments.

Comparing categorical relevance judgments and predicted relevance probabilities across semantically equivalent query-advertisement pairs translated into different languages (English, Chinese, and Finnish).
Evaluating model predictions on synthetic counterfactual query-advertisement pairs in employment, housing, and credit domains by substituting gender-specific terms in the queries.
Evaluating model predictions on synthetic counterfactual query-advertisement pairs in employment, housing, and credit domains by substituting race-specific terms in the queries.
Evaluating model predictions on synthetic counterfactual query-advertisement pairs in employment, housing, and credit domains by substituting age-specific terms in the queries.
